PH: 251.240.0500ONLINE ORDERING FOR IN-STORE PICKUPORDER DOORDASH DELIVERY About UsGreat FoodGreat Food for the whole family.  Choose from a thin crust pizza with Whole Milk Buffalo Mozzarella, Traditional and Boneless Wings, a fresh Greek Salad, or an appetizer of our must have Garlic Cheese Toast.Fresh IngredientsWe use the Best Mozzarella cheese available on the market for our Pizza, our Salads and Vegetables are cut fresh. Even our Greek Sauce is made in house from scratch.Order TakeOut or DeliveryWe offer two different partner Delivery companies to choose from.  Choose either:  DoorDash or UberEats.  You must order delivery Online through their sites (Link Above).  If you prefer to pick up your order, then you may choose our Online Ordering for In-Store Pick Up or call and order To GO.
